paper.title: The Apnea-ECG Database
paper.claim: The reference task classifies full-night ECG-derived one-minute epochs as apnea or non-apnea using expert respiratory annotations.
paper.population: The public database contains repeated overnight recordings from 32 subjects referred for possible sleep-disordered breathing; it is not a Brainstem validation population.
paper.referenceStandard: Expert minute annotations derived from simultaneously recorded respiration and related signals in PhysioNet Apnea-ECG 1.0.0.
paper.relationEvidence: The inspected source identifies itself as a personal Insight Data Science project and provides no evidence that it is the paper authors' implementation.

compatibility.brainstemContract: not-defined: proposed full-night beat-to-beat interval contract
requiredSignals: expert minute-level apnea and hypopnea reference labels
compatibility.window: Continuous seven-to-ten-hour overnight recording divided into non-overlapping one-minute epochs.
compatibility.preprocessing: Withheld until a participant-separated public reproduction freezes beat detection, artifact handling, feature extraction, missingness, and evaluation.
mismatches: Brainstem recordings have no expert respiratory apnea reference labels.
The inspected public evaluation splits records rather than identified participants.
The public source includes overlapping c05 and c06 recordings in its training index.
No Brainstem device or population calibration has been performed.

cohort.output: Withheld until participant-separated reproduction and protected validation support aggregate research output.

personal.output: Withheld; no apnea label, probability, score, or proxy may be returned from this candidate.
